description: This is a plush armchair with a rich, patterned fabric upholstery on the seat and back, contrasted with smooth, dark brown leather on the arms and base. The fabric features a complex floral design in muted tones of green, beige, brown, and hints of blue, suggesting a vintage or traditional aesthetic. The leather shows signs of wear, with some areas appearing slightly distressed or peeling, adding character and a lived-in feel. The overall construction appears sturdy, with a deep seat and supportive back, designed for comfort.
